policy: Sources are collection/reconciliation inputs only. Presence in a source never creates a feeding verdict.

sources.name: Kew World Checklist of Vascular Plants (WCVP)
sources.notes: Use source identifiers and preserve version/access date. Regional authorities may annotate or supersede regional occurrence.

sources.name: World Flora Online Taxonomic Backbone
sources.notes: CC0 static backbone advertised by WFO; preserve release/DOI.

sources.name: Catalogue of Life Base Release
sources.notes: Prefer Base Release for scrutinized sources; COL warns catalogue remains incomplete and may contain errors.

sources.name: GBIF-hosted Korean vascular plant checklists
sources.notes: Review each Korean checklist's publisher, geographic scope, date and licence before promotion.
